title: Databricks environment version -> local toolchain mapping
description: Transcribed from the published environment version reference. Databricks exposes environment version contents as documentation, not as an API, so this file is the one hand-maintained link between the version declared in the bundle and the interpreter pinned locally. It exists to make that seam explicit and checkable rather than implicit and assumed.
x-review-trigger: A new environment version ships. Not a calendar date - versions are the event, and a date-based review either fires when nothing changed or misses a version that shipped the week after.
x-why-not-an-api: There is no endpoint that returns the Python version for an environment version. Deriving it by starting serverless compute and asking sys.version would be authoritative but costs a cluster start per gate run, and would make an offline check impossible.
